Title: Fed Holds Rates Steady in March 2026 Decision
URL: https://www.cnbc.com/2026/03/18/fed-interest-rate-decision-march-2026.html
Published: 2026-03-18T18:00:12.000Z
Author: Jeff Cox
Highlights:
The Federal Open Market Committee voted 11-1 to keep the benchmark federal funds rate anchored in a range between 3.5%-3.75%. The policymakers are navigating higher-than-expected inflation readings alongside growing economic uncertainty.
